insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (Annual Sum Insured)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote:
Reset Benefit Unlimited (Not applicable for unlimited SI)

We will reset up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured, unlimited times in a Policy Year
great.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 7; Section IV(A)(7) Reset Benefit
great.explanation: Up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured is restored unlimited times in the same policy year (except where Sum Insured is unlimited). This can significantly increase claim-paying capacity after the base Sum Insured is used up.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote:
We will provide 20% Loyalty Bonus ... at the end of each Policy Year if policy is continuously renewed...

In the event of Claim, under the Policy during any subsequent Policy Year, the accrued Loyalty Bonus will not be reduced.
great.explanation: A 20% Loyalty Bonus is added at the end of each policy year on continuous renewal, up to 100% of Sum Insured (not applicable for unlimited SI). If a claim happens in a later year, the accrued bonus is not reduced, so your built-up cover does not drop to zero.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered. This helps pay for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days after discharge are covered. This supports follow-up treatment and medicines during recovery.

good.name: Room Rent
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 1 In Patient Care
good.explanation: Hospital room charges are covered for all room categories except suite. Choosing a suite can lead to extra out-of-pocket costs and may affect associated hospital charges.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section V(A) Pre-existing diseases Code - Excl01
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases and their direct complications are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. Claims for PEDs before 36 months will be rejected.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.
good.reference: Section V(B) Specified disease/procedure waiting period Code- Excl02
good.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage. Claims for these conditions in the first 24 months will not be payable.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Section V(C) 30-day waiting period Code - Excl03
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered for the first 30 days, except if the claim arises due to an accident. This means early non-accident medical costs soon after buying the policy are excluded.

good.name: Built-in SI Buffer
good.quote:
Loyalty bonus 20% of SI up to 100% of SI (Not applicable for unlimited SI)

We will provide 20% Loyalty Bonus ... at the end of each Policy Year if policy is continuously renewed
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 12; Section IV(A)(12) Loyalty Bonus
good.explanation: A 20% Loyalty Bonus is added at the end of each policy year on continuous renewal, up to 100% of Sum Insured (not applicable for unlimited SI). This increases your available Sum Insured over time without paying a claim-linked penalty later.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote:
Additional Base covers in Premium plan
1 Air Ambulance Cover Up to SI
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Additional Base covers in Premium plan
good.explanation: Air ambulance cover is available in the Premium plan up to the Sum Insured. This can help with emergency transfers, but it depends on being on the Premium variant.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Domiciliary (home) hospitalization is covered up to the Sum Insured as per policy conditions. This helps when hospital admission is not possible and treatment is taken at home.

good.name: Bariatric Surgery
good.quote:
Bariatric Surgery Up to SI

Bariatic surgery will have 36 months of waiting period
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 14; Section IV(A)(14) Bariatric Surgery
good.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered up to the Sum Insured after a 36 months waiting period. This means weight-loss surgery claims are not payable during the first 3 years.

good.name: PED Waiting Reduction
good.quote: On payment of additional premium, waiting period for Medical Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) ... shall be reduced to 24 months
good.reference: Section IV(C)(1) Pre-exiting disease (PED) waiting period reduction
good.explanation: By paying an additional premium, the PED waiting period can be reduced to 24 months. This can make pre-existing condition coverage start earlier if you opt for the add-on.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote:
We will cover ... medicines, drugs and consumables (other than those specified in the list of excluded expenses (non -medical) in Annexure I;

List of Non Payable Items ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ...
bad.reference: Section IV(A)(1) Inpatient Care; Section VI(B)(12) Non Payables List I
bad.explanation: Consumables are not covered if they fall under the listed non-payable items in Annexure I (e.g., gloves, masks). This can increase out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization even when the main bill is covered.

bad.name: Restore Restriction
bad.quote: The Reset Benefit will not be available for an Illness / Injury or related complications including but not limited to any relapse within 45 days in respect of which a claim has been paid in that Policy Year for the same Insured Person.
bad.explanation: Reset Benefit cannot be used for the same illness/injury or related complications (including relapse) within 45 days after a claim is paid in the same policy year. This reduces usefulness for repeat admissions of the same condition in a short time.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Additional zone based Co-Payment ... would be levied on each and every claim in case medically necessary treatment has been taken in a zone higher ... than the zone for which premium has been paid
bad.reference: Section VI(B)(1) Zone based premium (Zone based co-payment table)
bad.explanation: A zone-based co-payment is charged on each and every claim if treatment is taken in a higher zone than the zone for which premium was paid. This can materially increase your share of the bill whenever you take treatment outside your chosen zone.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
